# Zext Digital LLP

> AI transformation company based in Mumbai, India.
> Helps organizations use AI, automation, analytics and strategic
> advisory to improve revenue, cost, operations and decision-making.
> Serving clients across India, the UAE, and globally.

Tagline: Build practical AI transformation inside your business.

## About

Zext Digital is an AI transformation company that bridges the gap 
between AI ambition and AI execution. Founded in June 2025, 
headquartered in Mumbai. Our positioning is AI-enabled enhancement 
— not replacement. We work with existing systems, data, and people, 
layering intelligence on top. Working solutions deployed inside your 
environment in 2–3 months.

## Core Services

### AI Visibility & Revenue Systems
We help businesses improve visibility across Google, ChatGPT, Gemini,
Perplexity, LinkedIn and social platforms, then convert that
visibility into customer acquisition, qualified leads and measurable
revenue pipelines. Covers GEO, AEO, social-media customer
acquisition, founder authority, lead systems and AI-ready websites.
AI-assisted content production at scale across LinkedIn, Instagram,
YouTube, Meta Ads and WhatsApp Business (e.g. ~1 reel/day, ~75%
faster video production).

### AI-Ready Websites & Digital Assets
We build AI-ready websites, landing pages and digital assets with
clear information architecture, conversion journeys, analytics, SEO
and GEO readiness built in — full website typically in 2–3 weeks.
UX, IA & component systems; build, integrate & launch; performance &
accessibility; analytics, SEO & iteration.

### Enterprise AI Automation
We design and deploy AI agents, workflow automations and custom AI
systems across business functions, reducing manual work and improving
execution speed. AI agents, workflow automation, process automation,
custom AI systems and business-function use cases across HR & Talent,
Compliance & Governance, Operations, Finance and Sales & CX.
Four-phase approach — Discovery, Strategy, Pilot (fixed-fee, 2–3
months, with defined success metrics), Scale.

### AI Performance, Governance & Reliability
We help organizations monitor, govern and optimize AI systems across
cost, token usage, model selection, prompt design, accuracy,
compliance and executive reporting. Cost optimization, token
reduction, model optimization, observability, governance and
reliability.

### Business Intelligence & Decision Systems
We build MIS frameworks, dashboards, reporting systems and
intelligence layers that give leadership visibility into finance,
operations, sales and performance. MIS, dashboards, executive
intelligence, reporting, analytics and decision systems.

### AI-Augmented Strategy & Analytics
We combine strategic advisory, analytics, feasibility studies, DPRs,
business planning, financial modelling and investment readiness to
help organizations evaluate opportunities and scale with confidence.
DPRs, feasibility studies, financial models, analytics, business
planning and investment readiness.

### AI Capability Building & Academy
We help founders, CXOs, teams, institutions and professionals build
practical AI capability through executive workshops, corporate
enablement, cohort learning and FDE programs. Executive workshops,
corporate enablement, cohort learning and FDE programs.

## Products

### HR Pre-Screening Agent
Screens hundreds of candidates in hours. ~95% faster initial 
screening, 80% less recruiter effort, ~90% faster to recruiter 
review. Automated personalised outreach, objective evaluation, 
ATS/HRIS integration. DPDP and PDPL compliant.

### Content Audit Agent
Audited 5,000+ pages in under 2 days, identified 150,000+ issues, 
enforced 40+ custom rules. Continuous monitoring for compliance, 
brand consistency, and regulatory requirements including India 
IT Rules 2026.

## Platform
Single AI platform installed inside client infrastructure (AWS, 
Azure, or on-premise). Data never leaves client systems. GDPR, 
DPDP Act, PDPL, DIFC Regulation 10 compliant. Build once, reuse 
across all agents. First deployment: 2–3 months. Subsequent agents: 
faster and cheaper on the same foundation.
